data.body: `aws-region` (and, two lines further down in the same job, `AWS_REGION`/`AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`) is now set directly from `${{ inputs['region'] }}` with no fallback, even though the `region` input is `required: false` with a schema `default: us-west-2`. Every other workflow in this same PR that adds an identical `region` input (`ai-issue-implementation.yml`, `ai-pr-review-address.yml`, `ai-pr-review.yml`, `codex-issue-worker.yml`, `issue-triage.yml`, `notify.yml`) defensively uses `${{ inputs['region'] || '<default>' }}`. The schema default only applies when a caller omits the `with: region:` key entirely; a caller that explicitly passes an empty string (or any workflow_call chain that forwards an unresolved empty value) will send an empty `aws-region` to `aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials`, failing with an opaque region error instead of the clear `::error::` validation `model`/`reasoning-effort` get in the same `review-config` step. This is a recurrence of a previously reported, still-unaddressed inconsistency. Add the same `|| 'us-west-2'` fallback here and to the two `AWS_REGION`/`AWS_DEFAULT_REGION` assignments below for consistency and defense-in-depth; consider also validating the region format in `review-config` alongside `model` and `reasoning-effort`.
